name: codex-attack
description: Advanced cyber research workflows for Trusted Access for Cyber members.

interface.shortDescription: Advanced cyber research workflows for TAC members
interface.longDescription:
Codex ATTACK packages skills for scoped security engagements: scope modeling, source and web review, CVE research, binary reversing and debugging, selective fuzz harnessing, finding tracking, in-agent-browser HTML session monitoring, triage verification, exploit-chain analysis, and report writing.

Use only on authorized targets with Trusted Access for Cyber permissions.
defaultPrompt: Establish scope and review this target.
Perform chain analysis of known findings.
Launch an HTML session monitor while reviewing findings.
